variant: BOD2 gantry with vertical telescopic unit and COBOD robotic arm
name: COBOD Multifunctional Construction Robot (BOD2 with telescopic robotic arm)
summary: COBOD BOD2 gantry printer with a vertical telescopic unit and a robotic arm between the X-axes, so the machine can spray concrete (Shotcrete 3D Printing) as well as print it; other tools such as a paint gun, sanding head or block gripper can be mounted. First system delivered to TU Braunschweig's Digital Construction Site in Germany in July 2025.

germany.statusNote: COBOD (Denmark) calls the system commercially available and takes enquiries through its contact form; the first unit was delivered to TU Braunschweig in Germany. No price is published. The BOD2 base printer is sold in Germany exclusively through PERI 3D Construction (see the cobod-bod2 record); whether PERI also offers the telescopic robot unit is not stated.

sellers.name: COBOD International A/S
sellers.note: Enquiry form only; no price list. For the BOD2 base printer in Germany, PERI 3D Construction is the named sales route.

specs.label: Vertical range of telescopic unit
specs.quote: With a dynamic vertical range of 3 meters of the telescopic unit, the robotic arm can fully reach and manipulate an already printed wall 3 meters below the X-axis

specs.label: Base machine
specs.quote: The vertical telescopic unit is mounted between two X-axes on a COBOD BOD2 3D construction printer

specs.label: Process
specs.value: Shotcrete 3D Printing (SC3DP) plus concrete extrusion printing
specs.quote: integrates a telescopic vertical extension unit with a robotic arm that enables the Shotcrete 3D Printing Process (SC3DP)

specs.label: Other tools for the arm
specs.value: paint spray gun, insulation tool, sanding equipment, gripper for aerated concrete blocks or bricks
specs.conditions: maker statement; painting and block-laying shown only as illustrations
specs.quote: a variety of tools can be mounted on the new COBOD robotic arm, such as a paint spray gun, insulation tool, sanding equipment etc

notes: Not mobile: like the BOD2, the gantry is set up around the building; the arm hangs from a telescopic unit between the X-axes.
Delivered unit is fitted for shotcrete spraying; paint, insulation, sanding and gripper tools are maker claims shown as illustrations.
Arm payload and arm maker are not stated.

evidence.note: COBOD says the system will next be tested in real building projects with TU Braunschweig.

sources.title: World premiere for COBOD's Multifunctional Construction Robot made with TU Braunschweig (3 July 2025)

openQuestions: Is the telescopic robot unit sold in Germany through PERI 3D Construction like the BOD2, and at what price?
Has the system been used on a real building project after the July 2025 demonstration?
